problems.stem: Why might a chatbot get a recent event wrong?
options: It learned from data up to a cutoff date and may not search the web.
It is not allowed to use dates.
problems.explanation: Models learn from data up to a point in time; without search they cannot know later events.

problems.stem: Which use plays to a language model's strengths?
options: Getting exact statistics you will cite without checking.
Getting three alternative explanations of a concept you are studying.
problems.explanation: Re-explaining concepts is a strength, and you can judge which explanation helps.
